## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Include regression coverage or screenshots when relevant.

## Compatibility and risks

Describe migrations, configuration changes, security implications, and breaking changes. Write "None" when none apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, environment files, or generated bundles are included.
- [ ] Third-party material retains its source and license notices.
